quote: Imagine having a torta as a gf and having to do everything for her. That's the first 6 hours of this game. This game was made by femcels and propped up by its predecessors success. Absolutely terrible, so glad I got my refund.

author: iKraziee
quote: Terrible, through and through, the story is devoid of any character and there is absolutely no exploratory excitement like there was in Arceus. They had the recipe for a good game with the "legends" system and they absolutely muk'd it up. It felt like I was playing a direct sequel to X and Y on the same system. No effort, no heart, completely disappointed.

author: iKraziee
quote: My God was this repetitive slop, Arceus came out and made the "legends" system perfect. They attempted to improve it with this "sequel" only to completely ruin the system while allowing you to experience a watered down boring story devoid of any actual character and giving you the "illusion of choice" as if your decisions actually mattered. Complete disappointment.
